name: agentguard
description: Capability-based delegation for AI agents, enforced on-chain

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w gateway && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:ui: concurrently -k -n gateway,web,agent -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run gateway" "npm run web" "npm run agent"
scripts.start:hardhat: cross-env START_HARDHAT_NODE=1 RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545 CHAIN_ID=31337 DEPLOY_NETWORK=localhost node scripts/dev-all.mjs
